title: Marcos welcomes new Turkiye, Egypt ambassadors to PH
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday welcomed two new ambassadors to the Philippines, expressing optimism to continue forging closer ties with Turkiye and Egypt through their new representatives.
